bc.title: Performing Fire — The Broadcast
bc.about.1.label: 01 / EQUATION
bc.about.1.heading: Y = f(X) + ε
bc.about.1.body: X is what people bring. f(X) is the system's attempt to organize it. ε is what will not stay put.
bc.about.2.label: 02 / INPUT
bc.about.2.heading: X / TRACES
bc.about.2.body: People bring messages, voices, drawings, gestures, movements, hopes, fears, and short videos. These traces are X: the raw material.
bc.about.3.label: 03 / MAP
bc.about.3.heading: f(X) / THE MAP
bc.about.3.body: The proposed system embeds, clusters, and maps the traces. f(X) is its attempt to make them legible and manageable.
bc.about.4.label: 04 / REMAINDER
bc.about.4.heading: ε / WHAT RESISTS
bc.about.4.body: Mistranslations, contradictions, silence, strange gestures, and unclear signals resist the map. Most AI systems reduce ε. Here, we perform it.
bc.about.5.label: 05 / PERFORMANCE
bc.about.5.heading: THE REMAINDER BURNS
bc.about.5.body: A performer works inside or around the fabric totem, changing ε into light, particles, sound, glitch, and symbolic fire.
bc.contribute.1.label: 01 / WHAT TO SEND
bc.contribute.1.heading: LEAVE A TRACE
bc.contribute.1.body: Send a question, hope, fear, or imagination about technology. The text form is live; voice and video are interface studies and do not upload media.
bc.contribute.2.label: 02 / WHAT HAPPENS
bc.contribute.2.heading: TRACE → MAP → ε
bc.contribute.2.body: Your trace joins the work's input. The proposed pipeline maps it; what resists that map becomes material for performance.
bc.contribute.3.label: 03 / CONSENT
bc.contribute.3.heading: BEFORE TRANSMISSION
bc.contribute.3.note: SUBMISSIONS WAIT FOR MODERATION BEFORE PUBLICATION
bc.contribute.4.label: 04 / RECEIVED
bc.contribute.4.heading: ARTIST RESPONSES
bc.contribute.5.label: 05 / SEND
bc.contribute.5.heading: YOUR OFFERING
bc.experiments.1.label: 01 / STUDY
bc.experiments.1.heading: SCOPE SWEEP
bc.experiments.1.body: A scanning line reveals and erases a layered waveform.
bc.experiments.2.label: 02 / STUDY
bc.experiments.2.heading: MAGNET BREATHE
bc.experiments.2.body: A breathing magnetic pole bends thirty horizontal field lines.
bc.experiments.3.label: 03 / STUDY
bc.experiments.3.heading: LISSAJOUS MORPH
bc.experiments.3.body: Two frequencies drift, folding one trace through changing loops.
bc.experiments.4.label: 04 / STUDY
bc.experiments.4.heading: NOISE TO ORDER
bc.experiments.4.body: Random marks converge into a stable carrier, then break apart.
bc.experiments.5.label: 05 / STUDY
bc.experiments.5.heading: GRID PULSE
bc.experiments.5.body: A timed pulse compresses a grid and releases it to alignment.
bc.experiments.6.label: 06 / STUDY
bc.experiments.6.heading: RGB DRIFT
bc.experiments.6.body: Red, green, and blue copies separate around one moving form.
bc.research.1.label: 01 / STATUS
bc.research.1.heading: PROPOSED PIPELINE
bc.research.1.body: This channel documents the research direction. The full model, sensor, and performance pipeline is not presented as live.
bc.research.2.label: 02 / TRACES
bc.research.2.heading: AUDIENCE INPUT
bc.research.2.body: Messages, voices, drawings, gestures, movements, hopes, fears, and short videos enter as traces.
bc.research.3.label: 03 / ORGANIZE
bc.research.3.heading: EMBED + CLUSTER
bc.research.3.body: The proposed system embeds and clusters the traces, grouping patterns without treating the groups as a final truth.
bc.research.4.label: 04 / PROJECT
bc.research.4.heading: t-SNE OR UMAP
bc.research.4.body: A non-linear t-SNE or UMAP projection would make the clusters visible as f(X): a legible prediction layer.
bc.research.5.label: 05 / PERFORM
bc.research.5.heading: REMAINDER → FIRE
bc.research.5.body: The remainder, ε, passes to performer interaction: gesture-mediated light, particles, sound, glitch, and symbolic fire.
